This may be intentional, but the verification standard requires every call to be identified and matched; the current source does not preserve or document each full pushed expression at call sites.

It should be phrased as inferred from surrounding instructions, not directly from this decompile text.

- Either model `FUN_004c2550` call arguments as 32-bit values matching the decompile, or add explicit named helpers/comments proving the high words are irrelevant according to the callee.
- Revise `RE_AGENT_NOTE` to mark the `__ftol` numerator/divisor expression as inferred from omitted x87 setup rather than directly shown.
